comparisons.peer_summary: The cyber and information security program is supported by comprehensive governance policies covering third-party risk, data management, and regulatory compliance. Oversight is provided by the Chief Information Security Organization, with risks measured against an annual Cybersecurity Risk Appetite Statement approved by the Board's Risk Management Committee and Risk Committee to establish enterprise risk tolerance.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and C disclose a governance structure where the cybersecurity program is subject to regular assessment and independent review. MS reports that its program is assessed by Internal Audit Department (IAD) with results reported to the Board Audit Committee (BAC) and Board Technology Committee (BOTC), and is subject to annual independent third-party review. Similarly, Citi describes a program supported by comprehensive governance policies and measured against a Cybersecurity Risk Appetite Statement approved by its Board's Risk Management Committee and Risk Committee. Both entities emphasize board-level oversight and structured risk appetite or reporting frameworks, though MS explicitly mentions annual independent third-party review and regulatory examinations, while C focuses on the Risk Appetite Statement and CISO oversight.

sentences.text: Our Cybersecurity Program is regularly assessed by IAD through various assurance activities, with the results reported to the BAC and the BOTC.

Annually, key elements of the Cybersecurity Program are subject to review by an independent third party, the results of which, including opportunities identified for improvement and related remediation plans, are reviewed with the BOTC.
Our Cybersecurity Program is also examined regularly by the Firm's prudential and conduct regulators within the scope of their jurisdiction.

Citi's cyber and information security program is supported by comprehensive governance, including policies, standards and procedures that dictate requirements and best practices around various program aspects, including, but not limited to, third-party risk management, data management, asset management, information security practices, security incident management and regulatory compliance.

Citi's Chief Information Security Organization's risks and controls are measured against its Cybersecurity Risk Appetite Statement, which was initially approved by the Risk Management Committee of the Board of Directors and is reapproved annually by Citi's Risk Committee, chaired by Citi's Chief Risk Officer.
Citi's Cybersecurity Risk Appetite Statement leverages key risk indicators to establish enterprise risk tolerance and define risk management strategy with respect to cyber and information security.

comparisons.peer_summary: Goldman Sachs administers its Information Security and Cybersecurity Program through Technology Risk within Engineering, with oversight provided by the CISO and an independent Operational Risk team that reports to the chief risk officer. The program is periodically reviewed to respond to changing threats.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and GS disclose integration of cybersecurity risk management into overall enterprise risk processes with independent oversight. MS states that its Cybersecurity Program is assessed by IAD and results are reported to BAC and BOTC, with annual independent third-party review and regulatory examination. GS describes an Information Security and Cybersecurity Program administered by Technology Risk but overseen by an independent Operational Risk team that reports to the chief risk officer, which provides oversight and challenge of the program and assesses its effectiveness against industry standard frameworks. Both firms utilize independent internal teams (IAD/Operational Risk) to challenge and assess the cybersecurity program, ensuring it is integrated into broader risk management.

sentences.text: Our Cybersecurity Program is regularly assessed by IAD through various assurance activities, with the results reported to the BAC and the BOTC.

Annually, key elements of the Cybersecurity Program are subject to review by an independent third party, the results of which, including opportunities identified for improvement and related remediation plans, are reviewed with the BOTC.
Our Cybersecurity Program is also examined regularly by the Firm's prudential and conduct regulators within the scope of their jurisdiction.

Our cybersecurity risk management processes are integrated into our overall risk management processes described in the "Overview and Structure of Risk Management." We have established an Information Security and Cybersecurity Program (the Cybersecurity Program), administered by Technology Risk within Engineering, and overseen by our CISO.

This program is designed to identify, assess, document and mitigate threats, govern, establish and evaluate compliance with information security mandates, adopt and apply our security control framework, and prevent, detect and respond to security incidents.
The Cybersecurity Program is periodically reviewed and modified to respond to changing threats and conditions.

A dedicated Operational Risk team, which reports to the chief risk officer, provides oversight and challenge of the Cybersecurity Program, independent of Technology Risk, and assesses the operating effectiveness of the program against industry standard frameworks and Board risk appetite-approved operational risk limits and thresholds.

comparisons.peer_topic: Cybersecurity Governance Structure and Operational Risk Integration
comparisons.peer_summary: The governance structure for the Global Cybersecurity and Technology Controls organization is designed to identify, escalate, and mitigate cybersecurity risks. These activities are integrated into the Firm's operational risk management framework, including through escalation to management and the development of mitigation plans for heightened issues.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and JPM disclose that their cybersecurity governance and risk management activities are integrated into the firm's operational risk management framework and subject to independent review. MS reports that its Cybersecurity Program is assessed by IAD with results reported to BAC and BOTC, and is examined by regulators. JPM states that cybersecurity risk management and its governance are integrated into the Firm's operational risk management framework, with Independent Risk Management (IRM) independently assessing and challenging the activities of the Global Cybersecurity and Technology Controls organization. Both firms leverage independent internal audit or risk management functions to ensure the cybersecurity program's effectiveness and integration with operational risk.

sentences.text: Our Cybersecurity Program is regularly assessed by IAD through various assurance activities, with the results reported to the BAC and the BOTC.

Annually, key elements of the Cybersecurity Program are subject to review by an independent third party, the results of which, including opportunities identified for improvement and related remediation plans, are reviewed with the BOTC.
Our Cybersecurity Program is also examined regularly by the Firm's prudential and conduct regulators within the scope of their jurisdiction.
The governance structure for the Global Cybersecurity and Technology Controls organization is designed to appropriately identify, escalate and mitigate cybersecurity risks.

Cybersecurity risk management and its governance and oversight are integrated into the Firm's operational risk management framework, including through the escalation of key risk and control issues to management and the development of risk mitigation plans for heightened risk and control issues.

IRM independently assesses and challenges the activities and risk management practices of the Global Cybersecurity and Technology Controls organization related to the identification, assessment, measurement and mitigation of cybersecurity risk.

As needed, the Firm engages third-party assessors or auditing firms with industry-recognized expertise on cybersecurity matters to review specific aspects of the Firm's cybersecurity risk management framework, processes and controls.
